_comment: PHASE 3.5A style map: DOCX style name -> InDesign style name (colon form, group prefix included, exactly as in the IDML Resources/Styles.xml). Copy to <PRINT_DSM_ROOT>/style_map.json and confirm every value against the print DSM (RCF_Book_Print_Style_Map.md) and the template. Values below were derived from the DSM and checked to exist in Book_Templates_v4.idml, but the DOCX-side names are not confirmed, so every value is marked CONFIRM. idml_build.py treats any value that starts with CONFIRM or TODO as unmapped (it never guesses), so the build fails its checks until each entry is confirmed: delete the 'CONFIRM: ' prefix once checked. 'character' keys are DOCX character style names, or the direct-formatting keys direct:italic, direct:bold, direct:bold+italic, direct:superscript, direct:subscript. 'figures.path_pattern' is a glob in figures.tif_dir (relative to <CH_ROOT>); {chapter} = <ChapterName>, {short} = Ch<N>, {n} = figure number. Print figures are CMYK TIFFs (Figures/CMYK/); the PNG/JPG files in Figures/RGB/ are the eBook masters and do not satisfy the print build. Callouts are not in the manuscript DOCX, so they need no entry here: they are placed during layout from the PHASE 1/2 callout recommendations.
